an5.253:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asekhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekhena samādhikkhandhena . . . asekhena paññākkhandhena . . . asekhena vimuttikkhandena . . . asekhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena samannāgato hoti.
an5.253:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo ti. 1.
